notes.title: SickWay VR: Release Date Announcement Event!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GmINkipVSGc We are excited to announce that our game [b]SickWay VR[/b], which combines adventure, logic, action, competitiveness, and an immersive VR experience, will [b]officially release on Steam on January 14, 2025.[/b]

[b]SickWay VR[/b] will immerse you in a world of adrenaline-fueled rides high above the ground, where you’ll face tough challenges and various mini-games. Successfully overcoming them will lead you to your goal – back to the ground. :)

In addition, the game offers a unique [b]Track Editor[/b] that allows you to create, save, and share your own tracks. For those who enjoy [b]multiplayer experiences[/b], the game features a 4-player mode where you can join exciting races and compete to see who reaches the finish line first.

With a focus on realistic graphics, innovative controls, and a deep emotional atmosphere, SickWay VR is an experience you definitely [b]shouldn’t miss[/b]!

“[b]SickWay VR is the result of our desire to bring something special to gamers. The date January 14, 2025, is also significant for us, and we believe the game will find its place among you, the players,[/b]” says the game’s lead designer, Martin Vančo.

To stay informed about SickWay VR, join our community on Steam or our social media.
